title: USAG Industrial Equipment Maintenance & Repair Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > MISSION & INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND > 419TH CSB > W6QM MICC FDO FT LIBERTY
description:
The U.S. Government is seeking capable and responsible sources to provide non-personal services for the comprehensive maintenance, repair, inspection, and certification of cranes, hoists, scales, dock levelers, and vehicle lifts. The primary objective of these services is to ensure the continuous operational readiness, safety, and regulatory compliance of critical industrial lifting, weighing, and material handling equipment. 

  Scope of Services  

 The Contractor shall provide all necessary management, supervision, personnel, labor, equipment, tools, supplies, transportation, materials, and other items and services necessary to perform preventative maintenance, inspections, testing, calibrations, and emergency repairs for: 

 
	  Cranes & Hoists : Frequent and periodic inspections, preventative maintenance, and quadrennial load testing certified to 125% of rated capacity. 
	  Scales : Preventative maintenance, inspection, and calibration testing every six (6) months in accordance with NIST Handbook 44. 
	  Vehicle Lifts : Preventative maintenance and lift certification performed annually in accordance with ANSI/ALI ALOIMR2020 standards. 
	  Dock / Ramp Levelers & Trailer Restraints : Preventative maintenance, lubrication, repairs, and annual certifications. 
	  Unscheduled Repairs (Demand Maintenance Orders - DMOs) : Responsive troubleshooting and repair services under strict timelines (Priority 1: Emergency within 24 hours, Priority 2: Urgent within 72 hours, Priority 3: Routine within 15 days). 
 

  Locations  

 Services will be performed at geographically dispersed locations at Fort Bragg, North Carolina. Supported sites include Pope Army Airfield (PAAF), Camp Mackall (MAAF), Simmons Army Airfield (SAAF), and Range Operations. 

  Detailed Requirements  

 All work shall be performed in accordance with the requirements and standards set forth in the Performance Work Statement (PWS) for this procurement, including compliance with Army TB 43-0142, 29 CFR 1910.179, and various ASME/ANSI standards. 

 Contractor personnel must meet strict qualification standards, including five (5) years of maintenance experience for technicians and appropriate safety certifications (e.g., OSHA General Industry or Commercial Equivalent.) for the Project Manager. Contractor employees must be U.S. residents and successfully comply with all installation security requirements, including AT Level I, iWatch, OPSEC, and Threat Awareness (TARP) training. 

 Interested parties should refer to the PWS for a complete understanding of the Government's needs.
